name: image-to-editable-pptx
description: Reconstruct PNG and JPEG slide images as high-fidelity PPTX files with editable text and safe semantic layers.

interface.shortDescription: Turn PNG and JPEG slides into editable PPTX files.
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct a bounded PNG or JPEG slide canvas as a high-fidelity PPTX with editable OCR text and only safely extracted semantic PNG layers.
interface.defaultPrompt: Convert this PNG or JPEG slide into a high-fidelity editable PPTX with safe semantic layers.
